newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays weak in routine trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays weak in routine trade.

text.p: White sugar futures drifted off their earlier lows as sustained spread interest dominated an otherwise lacklustre session, traders said on Monday.

Earlier, commission house crosses on the second-month March contract and some trade interest in the March/May spread were the main features, but then light buying was noted in December and the nearby spreads attracted dealing interest.

"There's been good activity in the spreads but other than that it's been pretty quiet," said one trader. At 1538 GMT December was down $1.00 at $317.70 after touching an intraday low of $316.60. Technical analysts pegged support at $315.00 and said this was likely to be tested in the short term.
March was down $2.10 at $313.70 and overall volume totalled a solid 2,058 lots.
Activity was dull in Paris where volume reached 489 lots.
December was 50 cents firmer at $317.80 and March down by the same amount at $313.80.
